title: calophyllum tacamahaca var. parviflorum
intro: Calophyllum tacamahaca var. parviflorum, commonly known as the small-flowered Camphor tree, is a plant species in the family Calophyllaceae. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include potential health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial activities, aiding in the treatment of various ailments. The therapeutic actions of Calophyllum tacamahaca var. parviflorum include its ability to act as an antioxidant, anti-diarrheal, and antiseptic agent, as well as exhibiting anti-cancer and anti-viral properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential uses in traditional medicine.
